answer: An copycat hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The thread schedule is applied in cedar and cipher shows each instalment. A farm of 902 identities would post 1478 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
